name: 60062 · Northbrook, IL
findings: ZIP 60062 (Northbrook) has 322 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 88 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60062 (Northbrook) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 69 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
